Purpose: Lead-level CRM source for funnel, lead quality, attribution, and sales ownership.
Campaign/day marketing activity and spend used for channel efficiency and CPL.
Sales activity history used to derive first response time.
Quotation header records used to identify quoted leads.
Quotation line detail for product and quote-value analysis.
Sales-order headers used to identify converted leads and new orders.
Sales-order line detail for product and order-value analysis.
Synthetic intervention dates used for descriptive pre/post analysis.
Customer master used for customer/segment context.
Employee master used for salesperson ownership and response analysis.
Campaign master used to map campaigns to canonical marketing channels.
Product master for product-interest and order-line analysis.
Reference framework supplied with the practice dataset; not a Gold KPI table.
